source: CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death, 1999-2020 (controller D76)

acquisition.method: public web UI session (browser automation); export downloaded by replaying the results-form state with a plain requests POST (action-Export=Download, O_export-format=csv) against the session-bound action URL
acquisition.why_not_the_machine_API: the XML web service is national-only by server policy: any county/state/urbanization group-by or location filter is answered with 'Only national data are available for this dataset when using the WONDER web service' (probed live 2026-09-13)
acquisition.why_not_in_page_fetch: the controller refuses export replays issued as fetch/XHR from inside the results page; a plain requests POST without Sec-Fetch headers is accepted

query_criteria: Sex: Male; Ten-Year Age Groups: 45-54 years; Year/Month: 2015; 2016; 2017; 2018; 2019; Group By: County; Show Totals: True; Show Zero Values: False; Show Suppressed: False; Calculate Rates Per: 100,000; Rate Options: Default intercensal populations for years 2001-2009 (except Infant Age Groups)
suggested_citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Vital Statistics System, Mortality 1999-2020 on CDC WONDER Online Database, released in 2021. Data are from the Multiple Cause of Death Files, 1999-2020, as compiled from data provided by the 57 vital statistics jurisdictions through the Vital Statistics Cooperative Program. Accessed at http://wonder.cdc.gov/ucd-icd10.html on Sep 13, 2026 7:22:32 AM

contents.population_semantics: July 1 census estimate per year; the five 2015-2019 populations sum to pooled person-years

reconciliation.national_total_row: 514314 deaths / 104024440 person-years reproduces baselines.csv:all_cause_mortality_annual (0.004944) and validation/cdc_wonder_d76_national_year_age_sex_1999_2020.xml exactly
reconciliation.suppression_note: counties with <=9 deaths are OMITTED entirely (Show Suppressed: False) while the Total row still counts them; the 1897-death difference is suppressed small counties and must never be reconstructed

integration_status: eligible county context for county-wonder-posterior with a national prior of the identical profile/window (male, 45-54 years, All causes, 2015-2019); the companion sidecar .metadata.json carries the declared query metadata required by downstream.county_mortality.parse_export

reproduction_check.result: all 2773 lines byte-identical except the two session-stamped timestamp lines ('Query Date' and 'Accessed at'); sha256 of the timestamp-stripped exports matches: 8d6a8150403f6ecc2fc5a459aecf023b3297e100577aa8ed5fc4ea3073ec7e69
